def average_of_levels(root):
    sums, counts = [], []              # per depth

    def dfs(node, depth):
        if not node:
            return
        if depth == len(sums):
            sums.append(0)
            counts.append(0)
        sums[depth] += node.val
        counts[depth] += 1
        dfs(node.left, depth + 1)
        dfs(node.right, depth + 1)

    dfs(root, 0)
    return [s / c for s, c in zip(sums, counts)]

def level_order(root):
    res = []

    def dfs(node, depth):              # pre-order, bucketed by depth
        if not node:
            return
        if depth == len(res):
            res.append([])
        res[depth].append(node.val)
        dfs(node.left, depth + 1)
        dfs(node.right, depth + 1)

    dfs(root, 0)
    return res

def right_side_view(root):
    res = []

    def dfs(node, depth):              # right child first
        if not node:
            return
        if depth == len(res):
            res.append(node.val)       # first node seen at this depth
        dfs(node.right, depth + 1)
        dfs(node.left, depth + 1)

    dfs(root, 0)
    return res
